signature_moments: moments/<name>/contact-<n>.png: <what this moment is> (40ms per frame)

how_to_operate: Open headless with Python Playwright. Phone: viewport 375x812, device_scale_factor 2, is_mobile=True, has_touch=True; desktop: 1440x900.
There is a cookie banner on first visit; after looking at the first screen you may close it before scrolling.
machine_limits: Start only one browser instance for the whole review, at most one page open at a time, no more than 40 screenshots in total, close the browser right after; do not run several Python or browser processes at once.
